verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Machines have persistent storage and Shared Drives provide storage accessible across multiple machines in a private network, and Notebooks offer shared persistent storage, supporting datasets/checkpoints surviving instance teardown; however, no evidence explicitly confirms storage survives full instance deletion/teardown versus just stop/start, and no independent hands-on confirmation of durability across GPU rental cycles is present. missing for 10: explicit documentation on storage persistence after instance deletion (not just shutdown), independent/hands-on verification of checkpoint durability across teardown, and details on backup/retention guarantees.
